question: Whose fleets Germany's agents are handed, and how a surface fleet's share is weighed, on the running game.

addresses.name: CEU3AI_AssignSeaTargetsToAgents
addresses.comment:
**Hands every enemy convoy, enemy fleet, enemy war-industry province, recent raid on our convoys and friendly fleet to one of the country's unit agents.** Read whole on the listing, 0x48C140 to the single `ret 4` at 0x48D551. One caller, ProcessAI at 0x4899B9, at hour id % 24, for every country with a CEU3AI (before the played/AI branch split). No intelligence, sighting or detection is consulted anywhere: every unit of the countries listed counts, wherever it is. (1) The enemy list: CCountryList_AppendAll of `enemies` (+0x1008) and `undeclared_war_opponents` (+0x1018), then every tag of the strategy's WarTargets (CCountry +0x5D4) not already on it. (2) Every unit agent (ai +0x40): submarine_want (+0xD8) = 0; the lists +0x24C, +0x25C, +0x26C and +0x284 freed and zeroed; the vector +0x18C emptied. An agent's theatre is its root's area id (+0x68/+0x6C) resolved through FindPersistentById; its slot 65 is `mov al,1` on CAIUnit. (3) For each enemy on the list that is in the scenario (+0x44): (a) **each of its convoys** (CCountry +0xA0): c = CConvoy::GetDesiredTransports; for each agent whose theatre has ports (CTheatre +0x9C > 0): over every (path province of the convoy, port of the theatre +0x94) pair with NavalDistanceTo(port, province)/1000 < 3000: sumBase += port's naval base level_max/1000, sumDist += that distance; agents with sumBase >= 1.0 get the convoy's id appended to their +0x24C (every such agent, not only the best); score = max((want + c)/20/sumBase, 1.0) x sumDist/portCount, want being the agent's +0xD8 so far; the agent with the strictly lowest score (from 1e7, first of equals in agent order) gets +0xD8 += c. (b) **each of its naval units** (+0xBAC, slot 16 IsNaval): per agent, over the theatre's ports with NavalDistanceTo(fleet province, port)/1000 <= 2000: sumDist, sumBase (naval base level_max/1000) and n; needs sumBase >= 1 and n >= 1; score = max((CAIUnit_CountAssignedEnemyShips(agent) + fleet's ships)/sumBase, 1.0) x sumDist/n, x 0.2 (double 0x160A260) where our acting capital's area is a real area (slot 0) on the theatre's area list (+0x84); the lowest, first of equals, gets the fleet's id on +0x25C. (c) **war-industry provinces**: in the enemy's acting capital's area (a real area), each province whose owner is its controller and is hostile to us (at war, either side REB, or an undeclared war covering it - IsEnemy inlined) and which works at least one level of industry (the province's building of g_CBuildingDataBase +0x2C, level_current +0x24 >= 1000) or produces at least 1 crude oil (+0x27C >= 1000); weight 2.0 where it carries a real strategic resource (+0x18, slot 14), else 1.0; per agent, over every air base (COwnerArea +0x58) of every area of the theatre within CMap::DistanceBetweenProvinces 800: sumBase += air base level_current/1000, sumDist += d; needs sumBase >= 1; score = sumDist/sumBase/weight; the lowest, first of equals, gets the province pushed on +0x18C. (4) **Raids on our convoys**: the game state's finished-battle list (+0xB80, walked through CCombatHistoryEntry +0x28) - each entry of kind 2 (naval) with is_convoy_battle (+0x20) set, a defender (+0x18/+0x1C) that is real, not REB, and our side (CCountry::IsSameSide, or co_belligerent and not an enemy), whose tick plus one month (AddMonths) is not before now: every agent with a theatre port within NavalDistanceTo 2000 of the battle province and CCountry_IsSeaRouteOpen(us, port, province, false) gets the province on +0x284 (CAIUnit_AddConvoyRaidProvince), once per agent. (5) **Friendly fleets**: every naval unit of every country on our non_hostile_countries (+0xF98: ourselves and co-belligerents not at war with us) goes to the agent with the lowest mean NavalDistanceTo (ports within 2000, sumBase >= 1, n >= 1) x 0.2 on the capital's theatre - no load term - and its id onto +0x26C. (6) Every agent's +0xD8 = +0xD8 / 20, truncated toward zero. The name is ours. **The two reaches, read 2026-11-14** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 78): enemy fleets (0x48C91D) and own fleets (0x48D340) both skip a port more than 2000.0 away (`comisd dist, 2000.0; ja`), so 2000 counts, and both need the ports' naval base levels to reach 1.0 (0x48C988, 0x48D3AB). **Seen in the recordings** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 115): with step 4 as read - only raids on a convoy of our side - neutral Portugal, Turkey and Romania have no raided-convoy provinces and draw no patrol centre in 48 hours of July 1941, as the original's logged patrol draws show; a rule taking any raid on the side's own routes gave them patrols the original never gave.

**Read live** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 138; the score at 0x48CA6B, `[esp+0x30]`, the fleet `[esp+0x1c]`, the agent in EDI; the winner at 0x48CAA8, `[esp+0x48]`): Germany at 18 July 1941 02:00 hands 67 enemy fleets, the USA's 17th and 29th Navies among them through the undeclared war (`+0x1018` holds the USA; the WarTargets list `+0x5D4` is empty); the fifth goes to Berlin HQ, whose areas hold Berlin's though the province is Ob.kdo. des Heeres' - the British 7th Navy 218.743 there against 1093.714 unscaled.
addresses.evidence: Probes on the running game, 2026-11-19, as section 138 gives them; OpenHOI3 built to them gives the same scores to the thousandth and every wr19 fleet order. Wrong if a fleet's winner is ever not the lowest score so logged.

addresses.name: CEU3AI_DistributeFleetsToTheatres
addresses.comment:
Read whole on the listing, 0x48FBB0 to 0x490DA3: the `ret 4` at 0x4906EF is not the end - the surface-fleet half (0x4906F2-0x490BCC) lies past it, reached by the `jb` at 0x4905C4, and returns through the cleanup at 0x4906AF (trap 3); the throw stubs end at 0x490DA3. ProcessAI at hour (id+16)%24. (1) The fleets: every naval unit of the country with no ai_agent (+0x198) of its own, in the country's unit-list order. Counting every ship of them: carriers (carrier_size > 0), capitals, screens (neither, not a transport, not a sub) go into country-wide totals; a fleet holding any submarine is a sub fleet and its ship count (+0x40) is added to its current agent's sub tally; the others are surface fleets. A fleet's current agent is the topmost agent up its chain (the theatre's). (2) Sub fleets, each in order: over the agents with a unit and a non-zero submarine_want (+0xD8), score = (want - tally) - (current agent's want - tally + the fleet's ships), the current agent's term being -10000 where it has none or a want <= 0; the strictly highest above 0 wins, the first of equals. (3) Surface: per agent whose theatre resolves and has ports (CTheatre +0x9C), the carriers, capitals and screens (not subs, not transports) of the agent-less fleets under it are counted, and want = CAIUnit_CountSightedEnemyShips (0x4B96A0); nothing more when the wants sum to 0 or less. Else for each surface fleet in order (n = its carriers + capitals + other non-sub ships, transports included): over every agent with a unit, share = (that agent's warships + n, or - n for the current agent) / the country-wide total; score = want/sum of wants - share; the strictly highest from -10000 wins. (4) A winner other than the current agent: CDetachUnitCommand where the fleet has a parent, CAttachUnitCommand(fleet, winner's unit), replan_subordinates (+0x86) on both agents, and the tallies moved. No move order. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-agents.md, section F.

**Read live** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 138; 0x4908AC the held count in EAX, 0x4908E2 the want at `[EAX]`, the share at `[esp+0x40]`, the sum at `[esp+0x5c]`): Germany at 17 July 1941 18:00 - wants Ob.kdo. des Heeres 136, Berlin HQ 83, Trondheim HQ 9; the 33. Unterseebootsflottille, one transport, held -1 at its own Trondheim HQ and stays; the 5th Navy goes to Ob.kdo. des Heeres.
